newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian Hansapank in record share trade.
newsitem.headline: Estonian Hansapank in record share trade.

text.p: Shares in leading Estonian bank Hansapank were traded heavily on the Tallinn stock exchange on Friday, giving the market as a whole a record volume, dealers said.

Hansapank turned over a record 24 million kroons of shares towards the close as a trade of 100,000 shares and a number of smaller blocks hit the market. The large block was sold at 104.40 kroons versus a 103.80 close on Thursday.
"Probably foreign investors or core investors of Hansapank are behind these trades," Savings Bank dealer Charlie Viikberg said.
Hansapank has a quotation in Helsinki as well as Tallinn.
Dealers said that although the trade was large it represented less than one percent of Hansapank's share capital.
